findings.claim: The new shared ĐỌC-ZIP rule changes the B1a artifact contract from exactly one file to exactly one central-directory entry, and passes directory entries as files in tai_ve[id].tep. A ZIP with the required sole file plus an empty directory satisfies the pinned B1a file contract but is rejected by K2 or causes C8 in K7. GHIM-B1A says B3 consumes the pinned contract unchanged; no stricter archive profile is identified as a contract deviation. The shared rule propagates this mismatch to both receipt archives and all job/shard archives. Passing the 118 fixtures does not cover this raw-ZIP adapter difference.

manifestations.description: K2 counts an empty directory beside bien_nhan_audit.json as a second member and rejects an unchanged receipt.
K5 includes directories in tep; the unchanged B1a C8.mot_tep then reports C8 for one valid file plus an empty directory. Applies to both job stamps and shard artifacts.

evidence.observed_output: No-directory control: file_count=entry_count=1, both policies true. With empty/: file_count=1, entry_count=2, b1_one_named_file=true, b3_K2_exact_one_entry=false, receipt_unchanged=true.
Real stamp ZIP, recomputed archive/member hashes: files-only projection -> vi_pham=[]; all-entry projection -> vi_pham=[C8]. Without directory both projections -> [].

Pinned B1a names one file and an independently collected file list; B3 explicitly defines artifact members as every central-directory entry including names ending in /. Whole-file scan covers K2, K5, K7, acceptance 4/11/19 and the revision-history claim.

suggested_fix.where: ops/specs/wp1461-r1/SPEC.md §4.2 ĐỌC-ZIP, K2/K5 and acceptance 4/11/19; downstream parsing belongs in ops/cong_phat_hanh.py, not the pinned B1a artifacts. This shared adapter boundary introduces the divergent file domain.
suggested_fix.how: Preserve the B1a file-list domain when projecting an archive to tep and when counting the sole receipt file. Continue to read entries by ZipInfo and reject duplicate required files; filtering directories must not collapse duplicate files. The executed probe-k2.py and probe.py contain runnable positive/negative ZIP construction and hash measurements. suggested_fix.locking_test: Add case-owned exceptions for receipt, stamp and shard archives with one valid required file plus an empty directory; compare to the same archives without that directory. Keep two actual files and duplicate required-file entries as negative controls. A mutant that counts or projects directory entries as files must die specifically in these cases. The current spec has no such boundary case.
suggested_fix.may_spawn: Overbroad directory filtering could hide a duplicate file, skip unreadable real members, or accidentally change the separate release-package ZIP policy in §3. Keep the latter independent; do not edit the pinned schema/consumer merely to make the new restriction pass.

findings.claim: The new K8 per-part oracle assumes nhap_wd stage letters are identical to B3 checks (a)-(d) and assumes every helper failure returns a dictionary. Both assumptions fail on current master. nhap_wd returns c:zip for archive topology/open failures that violate B3 check (b), but the r6 rule marks every prior part dat, falsely recording 02=(b) as successful. Encrypted and unsupported-compression members raise exceptions outside the helper catch; the frozen mapping defines no K8 state/reason or journal behavior for them. Thus implementations can disagree or crash on the same input instead of providing the required complete three-state evidence.

manifestations.description: Stage-to-predicate mismatch: empty ZIP, extra file, extra directory, wrong sole filename and non-ZIP bytes all return c:zip, although (b) has not passed. r6 projects 02=dat and 03=khong_dat.
Escaping ZIP reader failures: unsupported compression raises NotImplementedError; encrypted wd.json raises RuntimeError. No returned ly_do exists to enter the frozen mapping.

evidence.observed_output: Healthy control -> passed. Empty/extra_file/directory/wrong_name/not_zip: five cases -> wd_khong_hop_le:c:zip. Unsupported compression -> NotImplementedError("That compression method is not supported"); encrypted -> RuntimeError("File wd.json is encrypted, password required for extraction"). Digests were recomputed and valid in every case.
Literal §4.3 projection for extra_file: 00=dat, 01=dat, 02=dat, 03=khong_dat, 04..07=khong_danh_gia. The actual archive contains wd.json and extra.txt, so (b) is false.

Current helper checks ZIP membership inside its c stage and catches only BadZipFile, ValueError, KeyError there. B3 check (b) includes ZIP membership; r6 assigns dat to all earlier stage letters. Whole-candidate scan also checked U7 row 6, K8 dependency rules, reason sorting, acceptance 5/11 and revision notes.

suggested_fix.where: ops/specs/wp1461-r1/SPEC.md §4.3 helper-result/per-part mapping and acceptance 5/11; eventual adaptation belongs in ops/cong_phat_hanh.py because ops/ci_provenance.py is outside the write set. Repair the semantic boundary, not the stable upstream helper.
suggested_fix.how: Define a truthful mapping between helper stages and the actual predicates. The least invasive option is to define journal parts as documented helper phases, explicitly putting ZIP topology/opening in the phase that really checks it, rather than labeling unproved (b) dat. If 01..07 must continue to mean (a)..(g), specify enough bounded archive evidence at the adapter to distinguish ZIP topology/open failures from JSON failures. Also define handling and fixed states/reasons for the measured escaping ZIP exceptions without blanket-converting programming errors into ordinary input failures. probe-a4-errors.py is a runnable measurement against the unmodified helper.
suggested_fix.locking_test: Use a dedicated case exception for each malformed-archive input, assert every emitted K8 part plus primary reason and final rc in chan/warning_only, and retain a valid wd.json-only control. Mutants that mark a prior unproved part dat or let the measured archive exceptions escape must die in their own named cases; unrelated exceptions remain false credit. Include the five topology variants and both escaping-exception variants measured here.
suggested_fix.may_spawn: Changing phase names can break diagnostic consumers and mutant targets. Re-reading ZIP bytes can introduce drift or duplicate downloads; bind classifications to the same verified bytes/digest. Broad exception catches can hide product bugs and manufacture khong_do_duoc. Keep existing no-dispatch and credential boundaries.
